default.notes: Brain-tier (3090). Nex N2.5 mini 35B MoE (3B active), Apache-2.0, Qwen3.5 MoE base. 22.3 GB GGUF: tightest fit; ctx 8192, lower if it OOMs. Competes with qwen3.6:35b-a3b. Thinking control (2026-10-16): its chat template always ends the prompt with an open <think> and ignores --reasoning off, --reasoning-budget 0 and enable_thinking=false, so the first token is a newline and DROP's newline stop returns empty answers (limit-50 DROP 0.0). The template's own switch reasoning_effort=none emits an empty closed think block; set via --chat-template-kwargs. Phase 4.5 (2026-10-17): thinking on gave no accuracy gain (BBH flexible 0.833 vs 0.837, GSM8K flexible 0.90 both) and was 23% slower, so thinking stays off; family prompt beat the benchmark prompt (DROP 0.60 vs 0.40); max_tokens 512 -> 1024 because the geoimport prep plan needs about 600 tokens (geoimport 0.845 -> 0.967).

interactive.notes: Interactive remote use (llm-gateway nex-split, five 1060s at tensor split 0.75,1,1,1,1, 3090 left free). Split placement from BENCHMARK_LESSONS_LEARNED.md 2026-10-17 (tested at ctx 8192; 65536 untested, hybrid recurrent KV is small). -fit off is required with n_gpu_layers 999; thinking off as in the default profile.

default.notes: Brain-tier (3090). Qwen3.8 27B dense, Apache-2.0, qwen35 arch, MTP layers (speculative decoding via --spec-type draft-mtp, untested). Expected successor of qwen3.6:27b and qwen3.5:27b. Thinking on by default in the template; --reasoning off gives a clean empty think block (litmus 3/3 clean). Prompt (2026-10-16): stays on the thinking-suppression family prompt. Two tuned prompts (v2, v3) chased the strict BBH/DROP extractors; once BBH/DROP gained flexible scoring the family prompt scored best (limit-10 DROP flexible 0.90 vs 0.70) and they were reverted. Real-use observation: on plain questions it sometimes answers in JSON ({"answer": "80"}). Phase 4.5 (2026-10-17): thinking on (end-of-text stops only) gave small gains (GSM8K flexible 0.90 -> 1.00, BBH flexible 0.878 -> 0.896, DROP EM 0.60 -> 0.70, IFEval prompt 0.80 -> 0.90 but inst 0.889 -> 0.833) at 3x BBH time (22 -> 67 min) and with runaway thinking (one BBH answer took 8402 tokens and 189 s, and was wrong). Thinking-on pipeline/geoimport at max_tokens 8192: equal or better everywhere (orchestration 0.75 -> 0.833, geoimport prep_plan 0.939 -> 0.970). Thinking on chosen for max scores (time is secondary below about 5x); max_tokens 8192 covers thinking, and reasoning benchmarks need --gen-kwargs max_gen_toks=8192,until=</s>. With thinking off, max_tokens 1024 is needed for the geoimport plan (512 cut it: prep_plan 0.0).
